reviews.comment: Widening is safe + correct, but goal unmet: Start/New-project/fs-list still 403 from LAN (separate remoteAddress loopback gate untouched). Needs human decision: keep read-only (A) or relax write/exec gates (B). Test gives false confidence.

fix.comment: Option B: removed the remoteAddress-loopback gate from fs/list, create, start so they're governed by the allowlist-aware isTrustedLocalRequest (register stays loopback-only). Split the misleading test into honest read-gate + write-family tests.

reviews.comment: Round 2: independent security pass caught an env-unset regression (forged loopback Host from a LAN peer reached the write/exec endpoints). Fixed inline with isTrustedActionRequest peer-IP defense + regression test.

fix.comment: Added isTrustedActionRequest peer-IP defense-in-depth; env-unset is genuinely localhost-only again for all client types. +regression unit test.

reviews.comment: Round 3: independent adversarial pass found NO bypass; forged-Host regression closed for all client types, option-B boundary correct. Approve. One pre-existing follow-up: /api/activity/:id ungated.
Human approved on review strength (option B + peer-IP defense). Merge to dashboard-improvements.
